title: Not great a darkening a room; not the best quality
text: Not great a darkening a room; not the best quality. I used these curtains for my daughters’ playroom and was hoping it would block out some of the light from outside. As you can see from the picture, the light comes right through. There have also been some minor issues with the quality of the curtains (as seen in the second picture attached). I would not purchase these based on the quality.

product_metadata.title: BONZER Stripe Window Curtains for Bedroom - Grommet Room Darkening Curtain, Thermal Insulated, Noise Reducing and Light Blocking Drapes for Living Room, Cloud Grey, 52 x 84 inch, 2 Panels
features: WHAT'S IN THE PACKAGE? Each set includes 2 red and sliver white stripe window curtains panels,with each panel measuring 52-inch width by 84-inch length. The curtains are finished with rust proof grommets with a 1.6-inch diameter. Lighter stripe is off-white, not pure white

PREMIUM BLACKOUT MATERIAL: Our room stripe curtain is made of 100% polyester. Crafted in a certified STANDARD 100 by OEKO TEX factory from a durable soft and thick triple weave blackout fabric which block out most of sunlight and UV rays. Darker colors work better.

UNIQUE STRIPE DESIGN: BONZER curtains takes elegant stripe design. Every stripe of the curtain adds visual interest to the plain drapery without overpowering that will add texture and grace to your bedroom, living room or any extension.

ENERGY EFFCIENT AND THERMAL INSULATED CURTAINS: These living room & bedroom curtains not only protect your furniture and floor exposed to the sun, but also balance your room temperature. They insulate from summer heat and winter cold, helping save on energy bills.
CARE IS SIMPLE: These curtains are machine washable and not easily deformed. You can wash with cold water and do not bleach. Iron on low heat if required.
